qualification.details: Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering Ph.D. in Material Science Candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis are also eligible to apply. Demonstrated research expertise in at least one of the following areas: Computational Mechanics (Fracture and damage mechanics, phase-field modeling, gradient damage modeling), Auxetic Structures (Design, numerical analysis, optimization and experimental characterization), or Composite Materials (Experimental and computational analysis experience of CFRPs and GFRPs, including mechanical characterization, damage and failure analysis). Strong background of computational and experimental mechanics, expertise in finite element analysis, scientific programming and advanced experimental techniques will be an added advantage.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Postdoctoral Research Position at IIT Ropar?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Postdoctoral Research Position at IIT Ropar is 30th August 2026. Ensure you submit your application well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or Material Science. Those who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis are also encouraged to apply for this research opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age limit for the Postdoctoral Research Position?
faq.answer: Yes, the maximum age limit for this position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided to eligible candidates as per the existing Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Postdoctoral Research Position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 60,000/- per month. This fellowship is provided to support the research work undertaken by the postdoctoral fellow.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for this position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their applications. Shortlisted candidates will then be invited for an online interview to assess their suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q6. What are the key research areas mentioned in the eligibility criteria?
faq.answer: The key research areas include Computational Mechanics (Fracture and damage mechanics, phase-field modeling, gradient damage modeling), Auxetic Structures (Design, numerical analysis, optimization and experimental characterization), and Composite Materials (Experimental and computational analysis of CFRPs and GFRPs).

faq.question: Q7. Are candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis are eligible to apply for the Postdoctoral Research Position. This provides an opportunity for those nearing completion of their doctoral studies.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates are required to fill out the Google Form provided in the Important Links section to submit their applications.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Official Notification PDF" link provided in the "Important Links" section of this article. It is advisable to read it thoroughly.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Postdoctoral Research Position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Postdoctoral Research Position is contractual. This means the position is offered for a specific period, as per the terms and conditions of the institute.
